known_gaps: Per-operation latency is not persisted; only whole-cycle duration is measurable.
Liquidity model covers the latest swing sweep only; equal highs/lows, session pools and internal/external liquidity are absent.
Raw/Valid/Quality/TradeCandidate/Confirmed are not separate durable state events; quality and assessment are payload fields.
The effective live FVG scan is timeframe 5 with 60-minute context; configured 15/60 FVG timeframes are not independently scanned per asset.
News is keyword/RSS screening with unknown severity and is not causal market-event verification.
The dashboard WebSocket loop can attempt send_text after a client close, producing RuntimeError in supervisor logs.
Ticker refresh failure is caught by the scanner but lacks a dedicated durable ticker-failure event.
Two legacy SENT outbox rows have no sent_at or Telegram message_id, so their historical API receipt cannot be independently proven.
The heuristic Score does not independently encode all final structure/liquidity/execution gates; Score 100 can still be rejected.
conclusion: SYSTEM WARNING; scanner and delivery workers alive, no pending delivery. Freeze V6.3; no source or threshold changes made by this audit.
